subject: Candidate cancellation / rolling coverage plan - Jordan Reyes
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Onsite scheduled: Jordan Reyes (Backend) — Sep 18 15:00 PT

Hi team,

Quick heads up — I scheduled Jordan Reyes (resume attached) for the onsite panel on Fri, Sep 18 at 3:00 PM PT. Panel: Laura (Hiring Manager), Tessa (Infra dive), Vivek (culture/leadership). Candidate confirmed availability and said they'll be onsite for a full day. I attached the latest resume and added the calendar invite.

Attachments: Jordan_Reyes_Resume.pdf, screencap-schedule.png

If anyone needs to swap out or can't make it, please flag here and I'll update.

Thanks,
Monica
Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes+applicant@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite scheduled: Jordan Reyes (Backend) — Sep 18 15:00 PT

Hi Monica —

I am really sorry to do this last minute, but I woke up this morning with a fever and a bad sore throat. I'm not in a condition to come in for an onsite or do video interviews today. I don't want to risk bringing anything to the office.

Would it be possible to move the onsite to next week? I'm available Tue/Wed mornings or most afternoons next week. If you prefer, I can also do a short take-home exercise to keep momentum.

Apologies again for the inconvenience. Please let me know what works.

— Jordan

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Jordan Reyes — candidate sick today (need coverage/reschedule)

Forwarding Jordan's note — he just messaged that he's unwell and can't make the 3pm slot.

Options I see:
- Keep the candidate on the schedule for a reduced panel later today (if any of you can cover) — we could do a short 30–45m loop with hire-critical interviews only.
- Move to a full reschedule next week (Jordan suggested Tue/Wed mornings).
- Send a short take-home to keep pace and rebook the panel later.

Can you reply with availability or preference? If we need to cancel today entirely I can open the slot for other candidates.

Attachments: Jordan_Reyes_Resume.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Jordan Reyes — candidate sick today (need coverage/reschedule)

Thanks for the ping, Monica.

Given the stage (onsite panel) I'd prefer to preserve the full loop if possible, but I'm OK with two fallback paths:
1) If we can get a minimal technical loop today (30–45m) with Laura + Tessa, we can keep momentum and decide on next steps after.
2) If nobody can make it today, reschedule for next Tue (Sep 22) 09:30–11:30 PT and ask Jordan to confirm.

Laura — do you have bandwidth to do a shortened 45m session later today (4pm) if Jordan recovers? I can cover the leadership/culture piece remotely if needed.

Tessa — if Laura can't, would you be able to take either the 4pm or the full slot next Tue morning?

If neither option works, Monica, please reach out to Jordan to propose Tue 9:30 or Wed 10:00 next week and offer a take-home as an interim.

Also: I'll mark the calendar invite as tentative and add a note that candidate is sick.

— Vivek
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Jordan Reyes — candidate sick today (need coverage/reschedule)

Thanks for the heads up. I can be available for a short technical deep-dive at 16:00 PT today (4pm) if Jordan feels up to it — 30–40m focused on systems design and tradeoffs. If he still isn't well or prefers to reschedule, let's move to Tue 09:30.

I prefer rescheduling to Tue so interviewers are fresh, but I'm happy to do 4pm as a backup to keep the loop moving.

Laura
Hiring Manager | Backend

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Jordan Reyes — candidate sick today (need coverage/reschedule)

I can cover the 4pm slot if Laura is needed for the tech deep-dive earlier in the loop, or take the full Tue morning slot next week. If we're doing a reduced loop today, I'd suggest: Laura (tech deep-dive) + me (infra) for 40m; skip the behavioral loop until we reschedule.

If nobody takes 4pm, I'm happy to keep Tue morning on my calendar.

— Tessa
Senior SRE | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Jordan Reyes — candidate sick today (need coverage/reschedule)

Okay — plan: Monica will reach out to Jordan and propose Tue, Sep 22 at 09:30 PT for the full onsite (Laura + Tessa + Vivek). Laura confirmed Tue works; Tessa confirmed she'll keep the slot. Monica, please send the reschedule invite and include a short take-home link in case Jordan prefers to do that first.

Monica: can you also add a short note in Greenhouse that the candidate reported illness on 9/18 and we rescheduled for 9/22, so the panel sees the context?

Thanks all for the quick responses — appreciate the flexibility.

— Vivek
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
